hooks.text: 吸收迷宫英雄灵魂中的能力，并以剑、法杖和枪刃切换战斗风格
hooks.excerpt: [ ■ Rogue-like action] Choose your favorite ability from the souls of the heroes lying in the labyrinthine castle and acquire it. Enjoy a variety of combat styles with one-handed swords, magic staves, gunblades, and more!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 安全模式保留全部物品，挑战模式失败掉落背包但提高稀有装备与高属性魔物概率
hooks.excerpt: Choose Your Play Style: Safe Mode A casual exploration mode perfect for relaxed adventuring. Even if your exploration ends in failure, you’ll keep all the items you found. Challenge Mode A high-stakes mode for those seeking thrill and reward. If you're defeated and fail to return, you'll lose all the items you were carrying. However, the risks come with greater rewards—rare equipment drops more frequently, and it's easier to capture high-stat monsters. Note: Even if you lose equipment, you may be able to buy it back from the merchant at home.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 所有魔物都能捕获、培养，并可细致设定个性后加入战斗
hooks.excerpt: [ ■ Monster training and battles] All monsters in the game can be captured. You can not only improve their abilities, but also decide their personalities in detail!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
